name: sheet
title: Sheet
description: A full-height panel that slides in from the left or right edge, built on <dialog>.

classes.name: sheet
classes.description: The panel. Put it on a <dialog> together with sheet--left or sheet--right.

classes.name: sheet__close
classes.description: Positions a close button in the top corner.

variables.name: --sheet-size
variables.description: Width. On screens 40rem and wider it is also the maximum width (default var(--max-i-sm)).

attributes.name: commandfor / command
attributes.description: Open with command="show-modal" and close with command="close", like a dialog.

attributes.name: data-dialog / data-dialog-action
attributes.description: Optional: data-dialog-action="click->closeOnClickOutside" closes the sheet when the backdrop is clicked.
